Methane accumulation.requires: coal measures liberating gas into a confined space
Methane accumulation.provides: explosive atmosphere, detectable by sensor, no warning to the unaided senses

Roof fall.requires: unsupported span in a stressed rock mass
Roof fall.provides: sudden localised collapse, audible precursors sometimes, immediate burial risk

Water inrush.requires: a hydraulic connection to a flooded body or aquifer
Water inrush.provides: rapid uncontrollable flooding, follows existing voids

Diesel exhaust build-up.requires: combustion equipment in a confined airway
Diesel exhaust build-up.provides: gradual asphyxiant accumulation, hours of onset, no explosion risk

Deep underground coal.provides: gas liberation, roof stress, restricted airways, long escape routes

Hard rock metal underground.provides: no gas liberation, high roof stress, diesel equipment underground

Open cut surface.provides: unlimited natural ventilation, no confined atmosphere, bench stability concerns only

Abandoned workings reopened.provides: unknown geometry, accumulated water and gas, no existing ventilation

Forced ventilation.provides: dilution of any airborne hazard, no effect on ground stability or water

Roof bolting and mesh.requires: access to install support at the face
Roof bolting and mesh.provides: ground support, no effect on any atmospheric hazard

Advance probe drilling.requires: drilling ahead of the working face
Advance probe drilling.provides: detection of water or voids before breaching them, no atmospheric function

Real-time gas monitoring.provides: warning of atmospheric change, no physical control of anything

Seconds.provides: time only for automatic systems and reflex

Minutes.requires: an event with a short onset
Minutes.provides: time to evacuate a working area

Hours.provides: time for planned withdrawal and correction

_v1_notes.HAZARD|MINE TYPE: methane is N in hard rock (no coal measures liberating it) and N in open cut (unlimited natural ventilation). Water inrush is N in hard rock as posed here and N in open cut, which drains to surface. Diesel build-up is N in open cut for the same ventilation reason.
_v1_notes.HAZARD|CONTROL: each control addresses one hazard class. Ventilation dilutes methane and diesel but does nothing for roof or water. Roof bolting addresses roof only. Probe drilling addresses water only. Gas monitoring warns of methane and diesel but not of roof or water.
_v1_notes.HAZARD|RESPONSE TIME AVAILABLE: roof fall and water inrush are N at hours - both are sudden. Diesel build-up is N at seconds and minutes, being definitionally gradual.
_v1_notes.MINE TYPE|CONTROL: open cut needs no forced ventilation, no probe drilling for water, and no gas monitoring - all N. Roof support of benches is Y.
_v1_notes.CONTROL|RESPONSE TIME AVAILABLE: ventilation, roof bolting and probe drilling are all N at seconds - none acts in that time, all are pre-emptive. Roof bolting and probe drilling are also N at minutes, being installed well in advance.
